# Acceptance Criteria

## Functional Criteria

- [ ] Given , when , then .
- [ ] Given , when , then .

## API Criteria

- [ ] Request and response payloads match the documented contract.
- [ ] Validation errors return the expected status and error body.
- [ ] Backward compatibility impact is documented.

## Architecture Criteria

- [ ] Controllers remain thin and delegate to application services.
- [ ] Domain code remains independent from adapters and infrastructure.
- [ ] REST DTOs, mappers, application services, domain models, and persistence adapters stay in their current layers.

## Test And Validation Criteria

- [ ] Focused tests cover the main behavior.
- [ ] Error cases are covered.
- [ ] Relevant architecture tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if endpoint, configuration, startup behavior, or developer workflow changes.
